limitations: Integrity evidence applies only to the defined canonical SCRD JSON representation protected by ANCH-2026-0001.
Linked and referenced external artifacts are outside the protected representation boundary.
A digest match establishes consistency with the preserved integrity reference; it does not establish substantive truth or correctness.
Satoshium Anchor does not certify or re-certify the underlying Atlas subject.
Satoshium Anchor does not adjudicate the Satoshium Certifier certification decision.
Satoshium Certifier remains authoritative for the referenced source object and certification domain.
Anchor Validation PASS concerns Anchor's own governed object and does not establish Attestor Validation.
Integrity evidence alone does not establish current Certifier lifecycle or certification status.
Eligibility does not establish the eventual Attestor Evaluation Outcome.
exclusions: Cryptographic-integrity claims covering the entire Certification Package beyond the defined SCRD JSON representation.
Integrity claims covering linked or referenced external artifacts.
Correctness of the Certifier certification decision.
Use of the digest match as evidence of generalized trustworthiness.
